candidate_binding_conditions: viable local exposure or contact opportunity
an initiation, mobilization, or recruitment response
local sustainment sufficient for episode renewal
candidate_negative_constraints: adjacency alone is not treated as reproduction
a violence-only adjacency contrast that does not exceed a temporal-lead placebo is not treated as propagation
static formation presence alone is not treated as persistence
violence totals alone are not treated as control
survival_criteria: predeclared mechanism direction replicates in at least two cases
mechanism improves a frozen holdout outcome beyond reduced models
mechanism adds value for control or joint outcomes, not violence only
direction survives case-input and measurement uncertainty
any geographic propagation claim exceeds topology-label and temporal-lead placebos
effect is not explained by a simpler statistical competitor
mechanism remains interpretable without holdout refitting
falsifiers: mechanism direction reverses across transfer cases
reduced model matches held-out control and joint outcomes
mechanism requires case-specific tuning to survive
mechanism changes violence but not the declared downstream construct
claim_rule: No mechanism is promoted from unresolved to general until every survival criterion is met in the preregistered case ladder.
